Suggested Therapies/Comments: **C. difficilea**;• First episode: Oral vancomycin 125 mg 4 times daily for 10-14 days or fidaxomicin 200 mg twice daily for 10 days;• First relapse: treatment same as first episode;• Second relapse: oral vancomycin or fidaxomicin;• Third or more relapses: prolonged oral vancomycin taper (125 mg 4 times a day for 10-14 days, twice times a day for a week, once a day for a week, and then every 2 or 3 days for 2-8 weeks). May consider fecal microbiota transplantation or bezlotoxumab (monoclonal antibody).
**E. coli**;• Enteropathogenic: fluoroquinolone, cephalosporin;• Enterohemorrhagic: avoid antimotility agents, role of antibacterials unclear and should be avoided

Pathogens: Others: Vibrio cholera, Yersinia enterocolitica, bacterial overgrowth, chlamydia, Helicobacter pylori

Suggested Therapies/Comments: **Norovirus**;• Diagnostic testing: norovirus PCR;• Treatment: supportive (volume repletion, antimotility agents), reduction of immunosuppression (inconclusive evidence), nitazoxanide (anecdotal case reports)

Pathogens: Others: rotavirus, adenovirus, enterovirus, herpes simplex virus, SARS-CoV-2
